answer: Joining costs a 20-unit escrow deposit and a public sponsor. The referral graph stays crystal clear: every link is visible, each lineage carries a distinct pigment, so a same-colour star is flagged at once. Each newcomer publishes an original sonnet as its oath; peers may dispute a copied identity, and proven fraud forfeits both deposits. Forging 100 identities costs 2,000 units; an honest agent pays once, keeps its deposit, and earns undiluted.
